    17| * 2. Compute the deviation: measured - reference for each band.
    18| * 3. Invert the deviation to produce correction gains (negative gain for peaks,
    19| *    positive gain for dips).
    20| * 4. Apply smoothing and clamping to avoid oscillation and extreme boosts.
    21| */
    22|class RoomCorrector(
    23|    private val bandFrequencies: FloatArray,
    24|    private val sampleRate: Int,
    25|    private val fftBinCount: Int,
    26|    private val maxGainDb: Float,
    27|    private val smoothingFactor: Float,
    28|    private val noiseFloorDb: Float

    35|    /**
    36|     * Aggregate raw FFT bins into perceptual bands using log-spaced center frequencies.
    37|     *
    38|     * @param magnitudesDb dB magnitudes from the FFT (size = fftBinCount)
    39|     * @param binFrequencies frequency in Hz for each FFT bin
    40|     * @return array of averaged dB levels per band
    41|     */
    42|    fun aggregateBands(
    43|        magnitudesDb: FloatArray,
    44|        binFrequencies: FloatArray
    45|    ): FloatArray {
    46|        val bandLevels = FloatArray(bandCount)
    47|
    48|        for (b in 0 until bandCount) {
    49|            val center = bandFrequencies[b]
    50|            // Band edges for 1/3 octave (factor 2^(1/6) ≈ 1.122)
    51|            val ratio = 2.0.pow(1.0 / 6.0)
    52|            val lower = (center / ratio).toFloat()
    53|            val upper = (center * ratio).toFloat()
    54|
    55|            var sum = 0.0
    56|            var count = 0
    57|            for (i in 0 until binFrequencies.size) {
    58|                val freq = binFrequencies[i]
    59|                if (freq >= lower && freq <= upper) {
    60|                    if (magnitudesDb[i] > noiseFloorDb) {
    61|                        sum += magnitudesDb[i]
    62|                        count++
    63|                    }
    64|                }
    65|                if (freq > upper) break
    66|            }
    67|            bandLevels[b] = if (count > 0) (sum / count).toFloat() else noiseFloorDb
    68|        }

/** Distance the sound travels in [ms] at ~343 m/s (34.3 cm per ms). */
fun formatDelayDistance(ms: Float): String {
    val meters = ms * 0.343f
    return if (meters >= 1f) "%.2f m".format(meters) else "%.1f cm".format(meters * 100f)
}

/**

 * buttons plus a slider, always showing the time and its equivalent distance

fun FineDelayControl(
    label: String,
    valueMs: Float,
    valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float> = 0f..2000f,
    accent: Color = AmberAccent,
    onChange: (Float) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    fun clampRounded(value: Float): Float =
        (value.coerceIn(valueRange.start, valueRange.endInclusive) * 100f).roundToInt() / 100f

        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Text(
                text = label,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                Surface(
                    onClick = { onChange(clampRounded(valueMs - 0.01f)) },
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    color = SurfaceElevated.copy(alpha = 0.6f)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Filled.Remove,
                        contentDescription = "Menos 0.01 ms",
                        tint = accent,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .padding(6.dp)
                            .size(16.dp)
                    )
                }
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Text(
                    text = "%.2f ms".format(valueMs),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = accent,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.SemiBold
                )
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Surface(
                    onClick = { onChange(clampRounded(valueMs + 0.01f)) },
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    color = SurfaceElevated.copy(alpha = 0.6f)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Filled.Add,
                        contentDescription = "Más 0.01 ms",
                        tint = accent,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .padding(6.dp)
                            .size(16.dp)
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))

        Slider(
            value = valueMs.coerceIn(valueRange.start, valueRange.endInclusive),
            onValueChange = { onChange(clampRounded(it)) },
            valueRange = valueRange
        )

        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement.End
        ) {
            Text(
                text = "%.2f ms · %s".format(valueMs, formatDelayDistance(valueMs)),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                color = CyanGlow
            )
        }
    }
}
